title: contracts
responsibility: Defines the machine-readable deploy state, evidence and identity schemas and produces stable canonical hashes.

inputs.name: canonical.value
inputs.description: Plain JSON value whose canonical encoding or digest is requested.

inputs.name: hash.value
inputs.description: Plain JSON value whose canonical encoding or digest is requested.

outputs.name: name
outputs.description: Schema for a canonical project or dependency name.

outputs.name: sha
outputs.description: Schema for a full SHA-1 Git revision.

outputs.name: digest
outputs.description: Schema for a lowercase SHA-256 digest.

outputs.name: runId
outputs.description: Schema for the unique deployment attempt UUID.

outputs.name: reference
outputs.description: Schema for an opaque provider or Tracker identifier.

outputs.name: environment
outputs.description: Schema for the canonical staging, preprod, and prod names.

outputs.name: action
outputs.description: Schema for the deploy and rollback action names.

outputs.name: pathFromRoot
outputs.description: Schema for a relative path under the reviewed script root.

outputs.name: migrations
outputs.description: Schema for ordered migration names and SHA-256 digests.

outputs.name: profile
outputs.description: Schema for bindings, secret names, migrations, runtime versions and flags.

outputs.name: observation
outputs.description: Schema for a time-stamped provider release and environment profile.

outputs.name: release
outputs.description: Schema for the immutable build source, artifact, toolchain, and migration manifest.

outputs.name: plan
outputs.description: Schema for one mutation attempt, related approvals and current rollback target.

outputs.name: signedProof
outputs.description: Schema for a signed approval or reviewer sign-off envelope.

outputs.name: deployment
outputs.description: Schema for a completed provider operation with read-back evidence.

outputs.name: smoke
outputs.description: Schema for routed version and passed smoke check names.

outputs.name: journal
outputs.description: Schema for the persisted phases, approval and verification results of a deployment run.

outputs.name: canonical
outputs.description: A deterministic JSON encoding with sorted object keys and original array order.

outputs.name: hash
outputs.description: The lowercase SHA-256 digest of the canonical JSON encoding.
